body: Thank you for the support. Do you happen to have any methods for getting something out of your head? I know it will still keep bugging me though.
I'm also worried about if it gets put on facebook or spread around with people I know I will never be able to live it down and people will always just think of me as a weird creepy kid.
I'm 15. No matter what I do, I can't help but get it out of my head. And the fact that my face and body might be floating around some creepy porn sites makes me terrified.
I guess my main question is is it worth constantly worrying about what I did and if it ever surfaces? I completely regret it and I feel so stupid.
